findings.title: Per-task grant budgets still lack exact task identities
findings.trigger: A fresh Agent verifies the durable grant before dispatching either D1 task, or the mutable D1 ledger later gains another named task.
findings.impact: The Agent cannot determine from the exact owner grant bytes which two tasks may consume the separate ZCode and Review budgets. Durable-grant verification must stop on that ambiguity, while treating every currently or subsequently named D1 task as covered could silently widen authority.
findings.evidence: The canonical D1 grant allocates attempts and Reviews to 'each named D1 task' but never lists either task id. The two current ids appear only in separate task contexts and the derived Review packet, neither of which can supply or widen the exact owner grant.
findings.suggestion: List `vnext-d1-runtime-safety-boundary` and `vnext-d1-host-enforcement-qualification` explicitly in the canonical D1 grant as the complete per-task budget set, and keep aggregate expiry unchanged.

coverage_refs: .ultra/reviews/vnext-d1-plan-review-20260901/SUMMARY.json unresolved review-spec-001 and review-spec-002 repair set
positive_observations: The revised environment contract closes parent finding review-spec-002 by keeping canonical packet paths launcher/worker-local and denying them to the final ACP/CLI Host.
The revised expiry now survives both task Reviews through aggregate D1 Review rather than expiring after the predecessor task.
limitations: This delta review covers only the parent's current P1 repair set and does not re-review or promote any retained parent P2 finding.
